units.source_text: 我覺得久留會很可怕，臉也沒洗就匆匆離去，

en.t: I felt that staying any longer would be frightening, so I left in a hurry without even washing my face,

units.source_text: 可沒想到的是，我當時脫口而出的「財竭緣盡」這句話，後來竟與我發生了意外的關聯。

en.t: but I never imagined that the phrase I had blurted out then, "when the money is gone, the bond is over," would later become unexpectedly connected with me.

units.source_text: 此後的一個月，我沒有再與那位一夜恩人見面。

en.t: For the month after that, I did not see that benefactor from the one night again.

units.source_text: 分手之後，隨著時間的流逝，我的喜悅之情日漸淡薄，

en.t: After we parted, as time passed, my sense of joy gradually faded,

units.source_text: 反而是受過她恩惠這一點讓我惶惶不安，身心皆感受到一種強烈的束縛。

en.t: and instead, the fact that I had received her kindness made me deeply uneasy, and I felt a strong sense of constraint in both body and mind.
